Proposition
[Diameter bound] Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0154, chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0155 1. Proposition 5.51\group positive-average-curvature

For a solution of the normalized Ricci flow on a closed surface with $R(\cdot ,0)>0$, the diameter remains uniformly bounded for all time.
